_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. config.json is gitignored - never commit credentials.

camera._comment: Reolink RTSP. Sub stream is 640x360-ish and plenty for this. Main stream only if sub is too soft.

detector._comment: yolov8n.pt is the fast one. yolov8s.pt if the room is dark and n misses people. Downloads on first run - do that BEFORE game day, it needs internet.

puzzle._comment: enabled_skulls: which zone ids count. min_people: guard against a solve when the room is empty and the model hallucinates.
puzzle._comment_hysteresis: Frames a zone must be continuously occupied before it latches ON, and continuously empty before it latches OFF. At 8fps, 6/12 = 0.75s on, 1.5s off. Longer OFF than ON so a momentary miss does not drop a skull mid-solve.
puzzle._comment_solve: hold_frames: all skulls must stay occupied this many consecutive frames before SOLVE fires. Stops a fluke single-frame alignment from solving the puzzle.
puzzle._comment_people: people_frames: the head-count must hold steady this many consecutive frames before it is published to system/People (12 @ 8fps = 1.5s). This number is the Mega's solve target (touched skulls == people), so phantom flickers must not move it. republish_s: how often the retained People + Skull topics are re-sent so a wiped broker or a rebooted ESP catches up.

zones._comment: Written by calibrate_zones.py. Do not hand-edit unless you know the frame size.

runtime._comment_dry_run: KEEP true. Since firmware v1.5.0 the Mega owns the solve (number of touched skulls == system/People head-count); SkullVision only reports the head-count and occupancy. false would let standing alone solve the puzzle, bypassing the touch sensors.
runtime._comment_preview: true = open a window with boxes and zones drawn. Needs a display. Turn OFF for unattended running.
